label: self-correction-type-mismatch
description: LLM first writes `const x: number = "hello"` (type error), then corrects to `const x: number = 42` on retry feedback

label: self-correction-implicit-any
description: Arrow function parameter missing annotation triggers implicit-any error; LLM adds `: string` on retry

label: clean-pass-no-retry
description: Well-typed statement passes on first attempt

input.statement: const sum = (a: number, b: number): number => a + b;

label: persistent-error-exhausted
description: Irrecoverable type error (e.g., calling non-existent method) exhausts all 3 retries

input.statement: const x: number = {} as any; x.nonExistentTypedMethod();

label: speculative-correct-annotation
description: Top-level await with correct `as Type` annotation; buffered statements type-check and execute

label: speculative-type-mismatch
description: Await annotated as `User` resolves to `number`; buffered statements discarded, nudge injected

label: speculative-buffer-overflow
description: Buffer token limit exceeded; pending section injected, LLM stream aborted

label: annotation-grace-first
description: First unannotated await triggers grace; shape derived and hint injected

label: annotation-grace-second-error
description: Second unannotated await (after grace used) produces kind:type error

label: nested-await-inner-mismatch
description: Nested await: inner frame mismatches, discards inner buffer only; outer continues

label: inferred-bindings
description: tsc-runner extracts inferred type for new const binding

label: session-context-cross-binding
description: New statement uses type from prior session context; type-check succeeds
